summary.text: Patrick O'Connor is a Republican state senator representing the 1st Plymouth and Norfolk District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his State Senate tenure as beginning in 2016, and his earlier work included service on the Weymouth town council.

paragraphs.text: Patrick O'Connor was born in Weymouth, Massachusetts, and graduated from Weymouth High School in 2003.

His career experience includes co-founding L40 Networks, working as legislative director in the office of State Senator Robert Hedlund, and serving as a regional coordinator for Kerry Healey's gubernatorial campaign.
O'Connor served on the town council of Weymouth.
O'Connor assumed office in his current district on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to committees including the Senate Global Warming and Climate Change Committee and, as ranking minority member, the Senate Ethics Committee and the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
